reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on their #north-random message. I said I've noted the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date is 10 June, not the date in their #north-team post this morning. I also pointed out that the wrong date is still up in #north-team, so they may want to fix it there.

I didn't take any other action, since they said none was needed. A renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed to post it.
